scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/app.spec.js tests/e2e/render.spec.js -g "opening one top menu|completes the three-step|keeps Render disabled|applies floor reflection" --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:stress: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/render.spec.js tests/e2e/preview3d.spec.js -g "20 floor-effect|repeated artwork replacement|context|DPR 2|HDRI" --workers=1
scripts.test:visual: playwright test tests/e2e/render.spec.js -g "Wave 5 deterministic Render baselines"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
